findings.message: Runtime permission regression: /opt/demo ownership changed from 584792:584792 to 0:0 and mode from 0750 to 0700. Application runs as _daemon_ (UID 584792) and must open /opt/demo/server.conf with no fallback. Root-only permissions deny the run-user write/search access, causing startup failure. Restore prior ownership and permissions or justify the requirement change.

summary: Source commit bumped from 0000000000000000000000000000000000000010 to 0000000000000000000000000000000000000011. Recipe parts and services unchanged; runtime-config part modified to alter /opt/demo ownership from daemon-owned to root-owned and directory mode from 0750 to 0700, breaking application startup.
